<reason>CON won by keeping the motion intact: likely net white-collar job loss was the load-bearing clause, and PRO never earned it. PRO’s best frames (cost-center caps, junior-rung hollowing, insurance) were real, but later speeches substituted transition pain, “jobs AI itself creates,” and prepare-anyway prudence for that showing. CON answered elasticity inside the budget-share loop and made the definitional counting a tautology, which left the cleaner vote.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>CON’s Rebuttal 2: a revenue-share cap is not a headcount freeze, and counting only thin AI-lab jobs makes net destruction true by construction.</best_rebuttal>
